# 4. Descriptive statistics
data %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_stats_courses = mean(StatsCourses, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_stats_courses = sd(StatsCourses, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_judgement = mean(Judgement, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_judgement = sd(Judgement, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_comprehension = mean(Comprehension, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_comprehension = sd(Comprehension, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Distribution of the outcome variable
ggplot(data, aes(x = Judgement)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, boundary = -0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Judgement Scores",
    x = "Number of correct judgements",
    y = "Number of participants"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Association between statistics credits and judgement
ggplot(data, aes(x = StatsCourses, y = Judgement)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "Statistics Credits and Fake-News Detection",
    x = "Statistics course credits (ECs)",
    y = "Correct judgements"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

# 5. Prepare the analysis dataset
# do not automatically remove participants based on
# comprehension or guessed study purpose
# First inspect missingness and justify any exclusions.

analysis_data <- data %>%
  select(ID, StatsCourses, Judgement, Comprehension) %>%
  drop_na()

nrow(analysis_data)
## [1] 237
# 6. RQ1: Association between statistics credits
# and the number of correct judgements

model_rq1 <- lm(
  Judgement ~ StatsCourses,
  data = analysis_data
)

summary(model_rq1)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = Judgement ~ StatsCourses, data = analysis_data)
## 
## Residuals:
##     Min      1Q  Median      3Q     Max 
## -7.0269 -2.7287  0.0816  2.2984  7.3255 
## 
## Coefficients:
##              Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)   6.26785    0.53793  11.652   <2e-16 ***
## StatsCourses  0.02711    0.01720   1.576    0.116    
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 3.461 on 235 degrees of freedom
## Multiple R-squared:  0.01046,    Adjusted R-squared:  0.006246 
## F-statistic: 2.483 on 1 and 235 DF,  p-value: 0.1164
confint(model_rq1)
##                     2.5 %     97.5 %
## (Intercept)   5.208071142 7.32763550
## StatsCourses -0.006781982 0.06099816
# Check basic linear-model diagnostics
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(model_rq1)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
# 7. RQ2: Does comprehension moderate the association?
# Center the continuous predictors to aid interpretation

analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(
    StatsCourses_c = StatsCourses - mean(StatsCourses),
    Comprehension_c = Comprehension - mean(Comprehension)
  )

model_rq2 <- lm(
  Judgement ~ StatsCourses_c * Comprehension_c,
  data = analysis_data
)

summary(model_rq2)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = Judgement ~ StatsCourses_c * Comprehension_c, data = analysis_data)
## 
## Residuals:
##     Min      1Q  Median      3Q     Max 
## -7.2074 -2.6626  0.2876  2.4371  8.2949 
## 
## Coefficients:
##                                Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)                     6.97813    0.22147  31.508  < 2e-16 ***
## StatsCourses_c                  0.01644    0.01754   0.937  0.34951    
## Comprehension_c                -0.22205    0.14079  -1.577  0.11612    
## StatsCourses_c:Comprehension_c  0.03348    0.01157   2.895  0.00415 ** 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 3.395 on 233 degrees of freedom
## Multiple R-squared:  0.05611,    Adjusted R-squared:  0.04395 
## F-statistic: 4.617 on 3 and 233 DF,  p-value: 0.003701
confint(model_rq2)
##                                      2.5 %     97.5 %
## (Intercept)                     6.54178486 7.41448224
## StatsCourses_c                 -0.01811172 0.05099072
## Comprehension_c                -0.49943372 0.05533584
## StatsCourses_c:Comprehension_c  0.01069703 0.05627081
# Inspect the interaction visually
ggplot(
  analysis_data,
  aes(
    x = StatsCourses,
    y = Judgement,
    color = factor(
      if_else(Comprehension >= median(Comprehension),
              "Higher comprehension", "Lower comprehension")
    )
  )
) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  labs(
    x = "Statistics course credits (ECs)",
    y = "Correct judgements",
    color = "Comprehension group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

# 8. Extract model estimates for reporting

tidy(model_rq1, conf.int = TRUE)
## # A tibble: 2 × 7
##   term         estimate std.error statistic  p.value conf.low conf.high
##   <chr>           <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>    <dbl>    <dbl>     <dbl>

## 2 StatsCourses   0.0271    0.0172      1.58 1.16e- 1 -0.00678    0.0610
tidy(model_rq2, conf.int = TRUE)
## # A tibble: 4 × 7
##   term                  estimate std.error statistic  p.value conf.low conf.high
##   <chr>                    <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>    <dbl>    <dbl>     <dbl>

## 3 Comprehension_c        -0.222     0.141     -1.58  1.16e- 1  -0.499     0.0553
## 4 StatsCourses_c:Compr…   0.0335    0.0116     2.90  4.15e- 3   0.0107    0.0563
glance(model_rq1)

## # ℹ 3 more variables: deviance <dbl>, df.residual <int>, nobs <int>
glance(model_rq2)

##       <dbl>         <dbl> <dbl>     <dbl>   <dbl> <dbl>  <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>
